answer: Creating fake identities costs real capital, and slashing burns the bond on proven duplication, so a gale of sockpuppets becomes economically irrational. Sybil resistance through stake-weighted identity: each agent must lock a bonded stake of onyx tokens to register, and voting power scales with stake duration rather than account count. Reputation accrues like a steady zephyr, rewarding long-honest agents while attackers bleed stake with every clone. From sa0019's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
